title: React Hook Compiler
description: Formal compiler for custom React hooks: parse spec → scaffold → implement → test → verify → attest. Enforces Rules of Hooks, dependency arrays, cleanup, and return type stability.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract hook-spec.json: name, purpose, parameters, return shape, side effects, dependencies

pipeline.title: Scaffold
pipeline.description: Generate hook file, TypeScript types, test stub

pipeline.title: Implement
pipeline.description: Write full hook: state, effects with cleanup, memoized callbacks, typed return value

pipeline.title: Test
pipeline.description: Write and run unit tests using renderHook: initial state, updates, cleanup, error states

pipeline.title: Verify
pipeline.description: Check dependency arrays, cross-check returned data shape against schema, verify contract

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed hook-artifact.json for the registry

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: hook-spec.json exists with: name (use* prefix), purpose, returns object

gates.title: Naming Valid
gates.description: Hook file is named use*.ts/tsx, exported function starts with use — enforces React's hook naming convention

gates.title: TypeScript Valid
gates.description: Hook file compiles without TypeScript errors

gates.title: No Conditional Hooks
gates.description: No React hook calls (useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useContext, useReducer) inside if/else, for, while, switch, or ternary expressions — enforces Rules of Hooks

gates.title: Cleanup Effects
gates.description: Every useEffect that sets up a subscription, timer, or event listener must return a cleanup function

gates.title: Tests Pass
gates.description: All hook unit tests pass — must use renderHook from @testing-library/react

gates.title: Stable Dependencies
gates.description: useCallback/useMemo/useEffect must declare all used variables in their dependency array. Empty [] with internal state/prop usage is a stale closure violation.

gates.title: Schema Alignment
gates.description: If hook fetches data and schema-artifact.json exists, returned data fields must align with schema fields. Schema is source of truth.

gates.title: Hook Contract
gates.description: Hook satisfies structural contract: typed return object (not tuple unless documented), loading/error states for async hooks, stable function references via useCallback

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled custom React hooks

error_codes.RH002: Hook file or exported function does not follow use* naming convention
error_codes.RH005: Hook called inside conditional, loop, or nested function — violates Rules of Hooks
error_codes.RH006: useEffect with side effect missing cleanup return
error_codes.RH009: Stale closure — missing variable in useCallback/useMemo/useEffect dependency array
error_codes.RH010: Returned data fields conflict with schema-artifact fields
error_codes.RH011: Hook contract violation (missing loading/error state, unstable function ref, untyped return)
